resources.string:
To use your Vizio TV remote for a WiFi app, you will need to first ensure that your TV is connected to WiFi and that you have downloaded the Vizio SmartCast app on your smartphone or tablet.
Once you have done this, follow these steps:

1. Ensure that your TV and mobile device are on the same WiFi network.

2. Open the Vizio SmartCast app on your mobile device.

3. Press the "WIFI REMOTE" button located at the top of the screen.

4. Select your VIZIO TV from the list of available devices.

5. The content on your mobile device will now be displayed on your TV screen. You can use your Vizio TV remote to control the app.

Note that some features of the app may not be accessible through the remote control and may require you to use your mobile device to control them.
